name: weak_generic
description: Speaks in generalities. Hints say the core element is never present. The controller asks for specifics once, then a depth probe, then a scenario where the contract has one, then moves on.

turns.say: I do a lot of repairs, I'm very hands-on and I love fixing things.
For a while now. It's a big part of what I do, I'd say I'm quite experienced.
Honestly I just work hard and stay persistent, that's the secret.
I'm always tracing faults, it's second nature. I use all the usual tools.
I'd check the equipment and talk to the right people, that's what I always do.
I'd get stuck in and start on the backlog, you have to be proactive.
First two weeks I'd get to know the sites and start taking call-outs.
It seems like a great company and a great opportunity to grow.
I'm passionate about engineering and I think I'd be a great fit.
Fixing things, mostly, and working with the team.
